title: Scaling Cross-Embodiment World Models for Dexterous Manipulation
authors: Zihao He*, Bo Ai*, Tongzhou Mu, Yulin Liu, Weikang Wan, Jiawei Fu, Yilun Du, Henrik I. Christensen, Hao Su
keywords: A cross-embodiment world model for dexterous manipulation that represents diverse embodiments (human hands, robot hands) as 3D particle sets with particle-displacement actions, enabling a unified graph-based dynamics model trained across simulated robots and real human data. Scaling training embodiments improves generalization to unseen ones, co-training on simulated and real data outperforms either alone, and the learned model supports model-based planning on robots with varied degrees of freedom.

title: Enhancing Generalization in Vision-Language-Action Models by Preserving Pretrained Representations
authors: Shresth Grover*, Akshay Gopalkrishnan*, Bo Ai, Henrik I. Christensen, Hao Su, Xuanlin Li
keywords: A VLA finetuning framework that preserves pretrained VLM representations for better robot generalization, combining a dual vision encoder (one frozen, one trainable), a string-based action tokenizer aligned with the pretraining domain, and co-training on robot demonstrations with vision-language datasets emphasizing spatial reasoning and affordances. Improves robustness to visual perturbations and generalization to novel instructions and environments.
